extDescription: Read manga like a real book: full-page fit, double-page spreads, right-to-left reading, page-turn animation and dark mode.
modeAutoTip: Auto: double page when the screen is wide enough
pressAgainPrev: Press $1 again to go back to the previous chapter
lastChapter: This is the latest chapter available.
helpRtl: Japanese order: you move forward to the left, like in a tankōbon.
helpLtr: Western order: you move forward to the right.
helpFootRtl: Click on the left: next page · double-click in the centre: zoom · wheel and swipe work too
helpFootLtr: Click on the right: next page · double-click in the centre: zoom · wheel and swipe work too
consentTitle: The site is waiting for your cookie choice
consentSub: Until the banner is answered, the site won’t load the next pages. Answer it, then reopen the reader.
loadingPagesSub: Move the mouse: the site waits for activity before sending the images.
chapterUnavailableSub: The site didn’t load the requested chapter.
hintOpenChapter: Open a chapter on a manga site to read it in book mode.
noPagesHere: No manga pages found here. Open a chapter.
hintEnable: Enable the reader to read this site’s chapters in book mode.
hintDisabled: Reader turned off here. Reload the page to get the original site back.
optCoverAloneSub: In double-page mode, page 1 is shown alone
optAutoOpenSub: Starts the reader as soon as a chapter is open
